description:
Get BRSR (Business Responsibility & Sustainability Report) ESG disclosures for a stock.

    Accepts NSE symbol, ISIN, or BSE code. `years` (1..10, default 3) caps fiscal years returned,
    newest first. Each year gives curated KPIs grouped as `emissions` (Scope 1/2 + intensity),
    `energy`, `water`, `waste`, `social` (female board/KMP %, LTIFR, fatalities, POSH complaints,
    CSR spend, ...), `governance`, and `meta` — each `{value, unit}`, raw as filed with SEBI.
    `include_raw=True` also returns the full ~800-concept BRSR map exactly as disclosed.

    SEBI's mandatory ESG filing for the top 1000 listed companies (LODR Reg 34(2)(f)). Raw
    disclosed figures only — never an ESG score, rating, or verdict (SEBI-RA line). Coverage
    starts from whenever the nightly refresh began ingesting the company's BRSR.
name: get_brsr
